newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hypo-Bank considers flotation for DAB unit.
newsitem.headline: Hypo-Bank considers flotation for DAB unit.

text.p: Germany's Bayerische Hypotheken- und WechselBank AG said on Thursday it was considering floating shares in its discount brokerage unit Direkt Anlage Bank (DAB).
"The DAB is to be converted to an AG (public company) as soon as possible," Hypo-Bank board member Martin Koelsch told Reuters, adding that the bank was also considering a flotation for the unit.
Koelsch said that on the New Market, the German bourse's segment for growth stocks, companies had only to be in the black for one year before being allowed to list.
He said DAB had turned a profit in the first five months of 1997, although the bank's target for breakeven is 1999.
